Ex: The children compared one state of growth to another as the larvae became caterpillars, then butterflies.

carnivorous

(adjective). (Dành cho động vật) Ăn thịt

Ex: Farmed cod and haddock are carnivorous and need to be fed other sea fish.

bait

(verb). mắc mồi

Ex: Do you have any stale cheese that I can bait the mousetrap with?

attack

(verb). tấn công

Ex: Most wild animals won't attack unless they are provoked.

artificial

(adjective). Nhân tạo

Ex: artifical flowers Ex: Her skin glowed in the artificial light.

approach

(noun). cách tiếp cận, phương pháp

Ex: The approach they were using no longer seemed to work.

apparent

(adjective). Rõ ràng

Ex: It soon became apparent to everyone that he couldn't sing.

trade

(verb). mua bán, trao đổi

Ex: Our products are now traded worldwide.

description

(noun). Sự miêu tả, sự mô tả

Ex: The name means ‘no trees’ and it is an accurate description of the island.

botany

(noun). thực vật học

Ex: Modelling of plant growth and architecture relies on biological assumptions borrowed from botany and crop physiology.

attach

(verb). đính kèm

Ex: I attach a copy of my notes for your information.

appear

(verb). xuất hiện

Ex: Symptoms usually start appearing within two to three days.

variety

(noun). Sự đa dạng

Ex: This tool can be used in a variety of ways.

suffer

(verb). chịu đựng

Ex: The company suffered huge losses in the last financial year.

resistant

(adjective). Kháng lại

Ex: Mosquitoes are becoming resistant to insecticides.

physiologist

(noun). chuyên gia sinh lí học

Ex: The proposal was influenced by the new interest shown by physiologists in the subjective conditions of visual perception.

epidemic

(noun). Đại dịch

Ex: A flu epidemic is sweeping through Moscow

threaten

(verb). đe dọa

Ex: Pollution is threatening marine life.

tackle

(verb). giải quyết, khắc phục

Ex: The problem is being tackled with a range of measures.

record

(noun). ghi chép

Ex: You should keep a record of your expenses.

infant

(adjective). ở giai đoạn sơ khai

Ex: The infant company was based in Germany.

highly

(adverb). rất

Ex: The US car market is highly competitive.

extinction

(noun). Sự tuyệt chủng

Ex:The island's way of life is doomed to extinction.

explosion

(noun). sự bùng nổ

Ex: How can we keep up with the information explosion?

controversial

(adjective). Gây tranh cãi

Ex: A controversial plan to build a new road has met with protests.

breakthrough

(noun). Bước đột phá

Ex: Scientists are hoping for a breakthrough in the search for a cure for cancer.

switch

(verb). đổi

Ex: I decided to switch my focus from swimming to cycling.

insecticide

(noun). thuốc diệt côn trùng

Ex: crops sprayed with insecticides Ex: The effect of these chemicals, particularly insecticides, has been studied for many decades.

waver

(verb). dao động, chập chờn

Ex: Her determination never wavered.

orchard

(noun). vườn cây ăn quả

Ex: Apple and pear orchards were planted, as were plum thickets between some holes.’

pest

(noun). Sâu hại

Ex: These birds provide a useful function in controlling pests.

soar

(verb). tăng vụt

Ex: Unemployment has soared to 18 per cent.

revive

(verb). phục hồi

Ex: The economy is beginning to revive.

resistance

(noun). sức bền, đề kháng

Ex: Many viruses develop resistance to drugs.

diversity

(noun). sự đa dạng

Ex: There is a need for greater diversity and choice in education.

ancestral

(adjective). thuộc ông bà tổ tiên, do tổ tiên truyền lại

Ex: Her musical gifts are a kind of ancestral heritage passed to her from her grandmother.

sceptical

(adjective). hoài nghi, ngờ vực

Ex: I am sceptical about his chances of winning.

impressed

(adjective). ấn tượng

Ex: We were all impressed by her enthusiasm.

discovery

(noun). khám phá

Ex: New scientific discoveries are being made all the time.

biologist

(noun). nhà sinh vật học

Ex: He plans to hire a wildlife biologist to help him understand better the dynamics at work.

pesticide

(noun). thuốc trừ sâu

Ex: Do not pour pesticides or herbicides down sinks, drains or toilets.

abandon

(verb). từ bỏ, ruồng bỏ

Ex: By 1930 he had abandoned his Marxist principles.

percent

(adverb). phần trăm

Ex: You got 20 percent of the answers right - that means one in every five.

leaf

(noun). lá cây

Ex: The leaves on the trees were beginning to turn from green to orange.

healthy

(adjective). khỏe mạnh

Ex: She was finally starting to look healthy again.

yield

(verb). sản xuất, mang lại

Ex: The research has yielded useful information.

trial

(noun). thử nghiệm

Ex: They're doing clinical trials on a new drug.

field

(noun). Cánh đồng

Ex: We had to walk across a ploughed field.

crop

(noun). cây trồng

Ex: The crops are regularly sprayed with pesticides.

damage

(noun). tổn hại

Ex: The fire has caused severe damage to the building.

considerable

(adjective). đáng kể

Ex: Damage to the building was considerable.

certainly

(adverb). chắc chắn, nhất định

Ex: Certainly, the early years are crucial to a child's development.

sections.title: Passage 3: Music - Language We All Speak
sections.html:
represent

(verb). thể hiện

Those comments do not represent the views of us all.

relatively

(adjective). vừa phải, tương đối

I found the test relatively easy.

proceed

(verb). chuyển sang làm gì, tiếp tục

He outlined his plans and then proceeded to explain them in more detail.

parse

(verb). phân tích cú pháp

When children attend to the input and repeatedly attempt to parse it, their performance undergoes a qualitative change.

fundamentally

(adverb). về cơ bản

The two approaches are fundamentally different.

formal

(adjective). có tính nghi thức, lịch sự, trang trọng

He kept the tone of the letter formal and businesslike.

extravagance

(noun). sự phung phí

Such extravagance is shameful when there are people starving in the world.

elegant

(adjective). thanh thoát, tao nhã

This is a fine building of elegant proportions.

construct

(verb). xây dựng

You must learn how to construct a logical argument.

syntax

(noun). cú pháp

The examples should always illustrate correct syntax.

reproduction

(noun). chất lượng âm thanh phát lại

Digital recording gives excellent sound reproduction.

mystery

(noun). điều kì bí

It is one of the great unsolved mysteries of this century.

migration

(noun). di cư

Scientists track bird populations and migration patterns.

manipulate

(verb). điều khiển, thao túng

As a politician, he knows how to manipulate public opinion.

intrigue

(verb). hấp dẫn, kích thích tò mò

The idea intrigued him.

individual

(noun). cá nhân

The competition is open to both teams and individuals.

indirect

(adjective). gián tiếp

Indirect effects of the fighting include disease and food shortages.

highly

(adverb). rất

The US car market is highly competitive.

contrast

(noun). sự tương phản

The flowers provide a contrast with the dark background.

connection

(noun). liên kết

Scientists have established a connection between cholesterol levels and heart disease.

aid

(verb). cứu trợ, trợ giúp

Huge projects designed to aid poorer countries can sometimes do more harm than good.

universal

(adjective). phổ cập khắp nơi

Such problems are a universal feature of old age.

evolutionary

(adjective). tiến triển

The findings are a significant addition to evolutionary theory.

auditory

(adjective). liên quan đến thính giác

It's an artificial device that stimulates the auditory areas of the brain.

obvious

(adjective). hiển nhiên

He agreed with obvious pleasure.

status

(noun). cấp bậc, địa vị

In the teaching of literature, Shakespeare is given a special status.

treat

(verb). đối xử

My parents still treat me like a child.

mere

(adjective). ít, nhỏ không đáng kể

It took her a mere 20 minutes to win.

frippery

(noun). câu văn sáo rỗng, vật linh tinh rẻ tiền

There's a lot to be said for keeping things simple and direct without too much frippery.

essential

(adjective). thiết yếu

The local government is not able to provide essential services such as gas, water and electricity.

acquire

(verb). nhận được, đạt được

She has acquired a good knowledge of English.

recognize

(verb). nhận ra

Most of us recognise the importance of diet.

virtually

(adverb). hầu như, gần như

Virtually all students will be exempt from the tax.

theory

(noun). giả thuyết; học thuyết

He has a theory that the hole was caused by a meteorite.

property

(noun). thuộc tính, tính chất

The substance has properties similar to plastic.

originality

(noun). tính độc đáo, mới mẻ

This latest collection lacks style and originality

observer

(noun). người quan sát

According to observers, the plane exploded shortly after take-off.

neuroscience

(noun). khoa học thần kinh

Thanks to advances in neuroscience, we now know that adult brains can grow and change.

necessary

(adjective). cần thiết

Food is necessary for survival.

interval

(noun). quãng thời gian nghỉ

He knocked on the door and after a brief interval it was opened.

influence

(verb). ảnh hưởng

His film is heavily influenced by other film-makers.

harmony

(noun). sự hài hòa

The designer’s aim is to produce a harmony of shape and texture.

grasp

(verb). nắm bắt

I grasped the opportunity to work abroad.

divide

(verb). phân chia

The questions divide into two categories: easy and hard.

devote

(verb). cống hiến

He devoted his life to serving his family, friends, and neighbors.

certain

(adjective). nhất định

You can choose to only watch certain kinds of movies.

attribute

(verb). cho là do, quy cho

He attributes his success to hard work and a little luck.

preference

(noun). sự ưu tiên, ưa thích

Many people expressed a strong preference for the original plan.

emphasise

(verb). nhấn mạnh

His speech emphasised the importance of attracting industry to the town.

combination

(noun). sự phối hợp

His treatment was a combination of surgery, radiation and drugs.

publication

(noun). ấn phẩm

The study is published this week as an advance online publication.

connect

(verb). liên kết, liên tưởng

Bad diet is closely connected with many common illnesses.

equally

(adverb). bằng nhau

Diet and exercise are equally important.

realize

(verb). nhận ra

They didn't realize the danger they were in.

utterance

(noun). lời nói, lời phát biểu

This was one of her few recorded public utterances.

underlying

(adjective). cơ bản, cơ sở

Unemployment may be an underlying cause of the rising crime rate.

shape

(verb). định hình

His ideas had been shaped by his experiences during the war.

reveal

(verb). tiết lộ

The survey reveals some worrying statistics.

random

(adjective). ngẫu nghiên

He grabbed a random pair of jeans and an old red shirt.

pattern

(noun). khuôn mẫu

Wages in both sectors have followed a similar pattern.

messy

(adjective). bừa bộn

The house was always messy.

imitate

(verb). bắt chước

Her style of painting has been imitated by other artists.

heritage

(noun). di sản

The building is part of our national heritage.

explanation

(noun). giải thích

The most likely explanation is that his plane was delayed.

emulate

(verb). cạnh tranh, tranh đua

to try to do something as well as somebody else because you admire them

emphasis

(noun). nhấn mạnh

Since the elections there has been a greater emphasis on education.

discard

(verb). vứt bỏ, loại bỏ

He had discarded his jacket because of the heat.

current

(adjective). hiện tại

Oil prices are expected to remain at current levels.

correspond

(verb). tương ứng

Your account of events does not correspond with hers.

conceivable

(adjective). có thể hiểu được, có thể nhận thức được

Books on every conceivable subject lined one wall.

colleague

(noun). đồng nghiệp

We were friends and colleagues for more than 20 years.

analogue

(noun). vật tương tự

He has been studying the European analogues of the British Parliament.

alternately

(adverb). luân phiên

The film is alternately depressing and amusing.

accompany

(verb). đồng hành

The text is accompanied by a series of stunning photographs.

abstract

(adjective). trừu tượng

The research shows that pre-school children are capable of thinking in abstract terms.

evolve

(verb). tiến hoá

The three species evolved from a single ancestor.

root

(verb). có gốc rễ ở

Vegetarianism is rooted in Indian culture.

notion

(noun). khái niệm

She had only a vague notion of what might happen.

entirely

(adverb). hoàn toàn

The experience was entirely new to me.

describe

(verb). miêu tả

Can you describe him to me?

abstract

(verb). rút ra, tách ra

The author has abstracted poems from earlier books.

previous

(adjective). trước

No previous experience is necessary for this job.

derive

(verb). bắt nguồn từ, lấy được từ

The story derives from a very common folktale.

demonstrate

(verb). trình bày, minh hoạ

New research convincingly demonstrates that age-related memory loss is not inevitable.

cast light on

(phrase). soi sáng

Recent research has cast new light on the causes of the disease.

appreciate

(verb). cảm kích, trân trọng

His talents are not fully appreciated in that company.

affinity

(noun). sự thân thuộc, sự đồng cảm

Humans have a special affinity for dolphins.

abundance

(noun). sự dồi dào

The country has an abundance of natural resources.

apparent

(adjective). rõ ràng

It soon became apparent to everyone that he couldn't sing.

recognition

(noun). sự nhận ra

He glanced briefly towards her but there was no sign of recognition.

perceive

(verb). nhận thức

This discovery was perceived as a major breakthrough.

laboratory

(noun). phòng thí nghiệm

The effects of weathering can be simulated in the laboratory.

feature

(noun). đặc tính

Teamwork is a key feature of the training programme.

evidence

(noun). bằng chứng

Researchers have found clear scientific evidence of a link between exposure to sun and skin cancer.

generate

(verb). tạo ra, phát ra

We need someone to generate new ideas.

regulate

(verb). điều tiết, quản lý

The department is responsible for regulating the insurance industry.

regardless

(adverb). bất kể

The weather was terrible but we carried on regardless.

rapture

(noun). sự sung sướng vô ngần

The children gazed at her in rapture.

extend

(verb). kéo dài, mở rộng

Careful maintenance can extend the life of your car.

continuum

(noun). thể liên tục

It is impossible to say at what point along the continuum a dialect becomes a separate language.

upshot

(noun). kết quả

The upshot of the discussions was that no one will be laid off.

necessity

(noun). điều cần thiết

Air-conditioning is an absolute necessity in this climate.

cognitive

(adjective). liên quan đến nhận thức

They are studying the links between cognitive and linguistic development in young children.

vastly

(adverb). rộng lớn

The quality of the training has vastly improved.

unlock

(verb). mở khóa, giải phóng

Drama helps to unlock young people’s creative talents.

mechanism

(noun). cơ chế hoạt động

These automatic cameras have a special focusing mechanism.

identity

(noun). cá tính, đặc tính

Scotland has never lost its identity as a separate nation.

philosopher

(noun). nhà triết học

We studied the writings of the Greek philosopher Aristotle.

note

(verb). chú ý, nhận thấy

It should be noted that dissertations submitted late will not be accepted.

discover

(verb). khám phá

She recently discovered two fungi that were new to science.

dimension

(noun). kích thước, chiều

We measured the dimensions of the kitchen.

basis

(noun). nền tảng

The basis of a good marriage is trust.

intricately

(adverb). phức tạp

The hijacking operation was intricately planned.

influence

(noun). ảnh hưởng

His early work shows the influence of Cézanne and Matisse.

related

(adjective). liên quan

These problems are closely related.

trait

(noun). đặc điểm

She shares several character traits with her father.

argue

(verb). tranh luận

Critics argue that Britain is not investing enough in broadband.

reproduce

(verb). sao chép, chép lại

The photocopier reproduces colours very well.

exist

(verb). tồn tại

I don't think ghosts exist.

discuss

(verb). thảo luận

Have you discussed the problem with anyone?

critic

(noun). nhà phê bình

The critics loved the movie.

aspect

(noun). khía cạnh

The book aims to cover all aspects of city life.

repertoire

(noun). vốn tiết mục

a pianist with a wide repertoire He accompanied one of the dances, and his repertoire of bagpipe tunes is extensive.

novel

(adjective). mới lạ

It was an American who came up with the novel idea of drive-in restaurants.

inconclusive

(adjective). không dẫn đến được kết luận

The medical tests were inconclusive, and will need to be repeated.

reference

(noun). sự nói đến, sự nhắc đến

She made no reference to her illness but only to her future plans.

mention

(verb). nhắc đến, đề cập

I promised never to mention the incident again.
